notes.title: 40% discount!
notes.notes:
We're here! Come meet us in this charming neighborhood full of details and gorgeous girls!

During the launch, we're offering a 40% discount! Enjoy it, and let us know which of the girls you enjoyed getting to know the most!

Each house you enter holds its own secrets, with rooms meticulously designed to captivate your imagination. Whether you’re exploring the vibrant living rooms or uncovering hidden corners, every detail has been crafted to provide an immersive experience like no other. The girls in this neighborhood are not just characters—they're your companions in this journey, each with her own unique personality and story to discover.

Take your time to customize your experience fully, from the girls' appearances to the intimate moments you share. With endless possibilities, you can create connections that feel personal and meaningful. Don’t miss out on this opportunity to dive deep into a world of beauty, intrigue, and passion!
